(Search snippet content — ISW / Critical Threats assessment 7 Aug 2026 + Al Jazeera; own reporting language)

ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, 7 August 2026:
- Russia launched 147 Shahed-type drones against Ukraine overnight into 7 Aug; air defences downed 114, the Air Force said.
- Putin reportedly held a phone call on 6 August with the commander of the 76th Guards VDV (Airborne) division, indicating Russian forces are prioritising advances in the Pokrovsk and Dobropillya directions with intent to encircle Ukraine's "Fortress Belt" from the south-west.
- ISW assessment: the Russian timelines for completing this wide envelopment are "extremely unrealistic". The call is likely also a response to accusations that Putin is out of touch with battlefield reality.
- Ukraine's intermediate-range strike campaign against the Russian rear, plus Ukrainian tactical-drone overmatch on the frontline, are slowing Russian operational tempo across the front.

Al Jazeera, 7 Aug 2026: "Several killed in attacks on Ukraine as Kyiv hits Russian e-commerce giant" — Ukraine continues to strike warehouses/logistics hubs run by Wildberries, which it says aid Moscow's war effort.

US Senate: passed a long-stalled bill imposing sweeping new sanctions on Russia and extending measures against Iran (championed by the late Sen. Lindsey Graham) — would allow steep tariffs on the biggest buyers of Russian energy and target banks and the "shadow fleet". Still requires House approval.
